audit_items.proof_trace: The elapsed-time formula is implemented exactly as the assertion requires: `simple_interest_factor = interest_rate.mul_u64(now - last_updated)` and `interest_accumulated = self.debt.mul(simple_interest_factor)` (reserve.move:139-140). `now` is derived from the Sui system Clock (`clock.timestamp_ms() / 1000`), which cannot be manipulated by external callers. Double-accrual is blocked by the early-return guard `if (last_updated == now) { return }` (reserve.move:132-134), and `borrow_index.set_value` enforces monotonicity of both index and timestamp. The `repay_fee_rate`-as-`reserve_factor` substitution in market.move:1025 affects only `cash_reserve` (protocol fee share) and does not alter the `self.debt` accumulation path, so it does not inflate or miscount interest under this property.
